entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I ordered something and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the website, I wasn't sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?
Oh, right. Let me see... It's VF88602. It's for a jersey I bought. I'm just not sure I got the right thing.

Okay, I have your order pulled up here. I see the Aero-Weave Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's... it's the wrong size. I followed the chart, I think, but it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping I could do an exchange or something like that.
I understand. So it's a fit preference, not a defect with the jersey itself. Let me just quickly check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I'm sorry, I hope this isn't a problem. Can't you just help me? I find this all very overwhelming.

It's no problem at all, and I'm happy to help. Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like you received the item 13 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So, you are well within the timeframe to make a return.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. So what do I do now?

I can process that for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label. You can just package the item back up, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to set up the exchange for the next size up?
An exchange would be perfect! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so much easier for me.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that email with the label and the details for your exchange. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
